public_saas_home_body: Write, review, publish and see what it did — in one window. No approvals chased through chat, no jumping between the editor, the calendar and the channels.
public_saas_product_title: One workflow from plan to publication
public_saas_product_body: Coordinate planning, drafting, review, scheduling, connected channels and production status in one working surface.
public_saas_available_body: Plan launches, create and review drafts, connect supported channels, and schedule approved work from the shared calendar.
public_saas_roadmap_body: More starter workflows and deeper automation remain planned work. The public demo does not promise or simulate those integrations.
public_saas_security_body: The demo does not call tenant or content-mutation APIs, AI, OAuth, publishing, Temporal, or paid providers; it emits only one allowlisted first-party aggregate event and preserves a visible AGPL source link.
public_saas_tenant_isolation_body: Authenticated workspace requests are scoped to the active organization. The public demo never reads tenant data.
public_saas_encrypted_keys_body: Workspace-provided AI keys are encrypted at rest and are not exposed to the public interface.
public_saas_backup_recovery_body: Backups and recovery are operator responsibilities. Availability and retention depend on the deployment operator.
public_saas_deletion_export_body: Workspace deletion and data export require an authenticated product flow; the public pages do not perform either action.
public_saas_security_limits_body: This page describes product boundaries, not a certification. Verify deployment, retention, and incident practices with your operator.
public_saas_docs_body: See how planning, drafts, review and scheduling fit together before connecting a channel or creating a workspace.
public_saas_docs_plan_body: Create a launch, set its goal and audience, then choose which connected channels it should use.
public_saas_docs_review_body: Prepare channel-ready drafts, inspect the result, and approve only the content that is ready to continue.
public_saas_docs_schedule_body: Place approved items on the calendar and confirm timing before any real publishing action.
public_saas_demo_body: Write your own text and carry it through every step. Nothing is published and no workspace data is read.
public_saas_plan_detail: Write your own text or keep the sample — it is what goes through every step from here.
public_saas_draft_detail: Choose the channels this goes to — one material, several at once — and see the same text against each of their limits. Add a couple of lines and watch where it stops fitting.
public_saas_review_detail: Send the material for review and approve it — until it is approved it cannot be scheduled.
public_saas_schedule_detail: Choose the date and time it goes out.
public_saas_email_body: Continue with email, then finish your workspace details in the next step.
public_saas_newsletter_consent: Send me occasional product news and updates by email.

public_saas_sample_lead: Attention has moved to short formats, but the editorial process has not.
public_saas_sample_body: What to change in the quarterly plan: a series of six videos and a written breakdown of each.
public_saas_idea_title: Find ideas nobody has written about in English yet
public_saas_idea_body: The system searches sources in other languages itself and prepares the material in your audience’s — you do not have to read a word of them. Every fact it keeps keeps the link it came from.
public_saas_idea_thesis: Short video is taking B2B attention — build the quarter around a series of six.
public_saas_draft_title: Turn the idea into a finished text
public_saas_draft_body: Draft, images, links and tags in one place. The text saves itself, nothing gets lost, and it is always clear what is ready to hand over.
public_saas_draft_section_body: Short clips get more reach and engagement. A series of six covers the quarterly video plan and gives material for the written breakdowns.
public_saas_brand_voice_body: Describe the tone, the words you want and the ones you do not — once — and every publication will sound recognisably the same.
public_saas_adapt_title: One text, a ready version for every channel
public_saas_adapt_body: Do not rewrite the post five times by hand. Assemble versions that fit the length and format of each platform, then send them in one action.
public_saas_adapt_note: Platforms can do different things: one takes a long read, another only a short caption under a photo. The limits are visible up front, not after a publication is refused.
public_saas_adapt_text_telegram: Short video is taking B2B attention. Here is what changes in the quarterly plan: a six-episode series, a written breakdown of each, one summary report.
public_saas_adapt_sync_note: An edit in the source text carries into every version.
public_saas_approve_title: Carry the material through to its publication date
public_saas_approve_body: You can see who has the material, what they are asking to fix and when it goes out. Approve it and the publication takes its place in the calendar.
public_saas_comment_one_body: The second paragraph needs a link to the video data source.
public_saas_comment_two_body: Link added, the channel versions are updated.
public_saas_calendar_weekdays: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su
public_saas_platforms_title: Social networks, blogs, communities and newsletters — from one window
public_saas_platforms_body: More than 30 integration options: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, LinkedIn, WordPress, newsletters and other destinations. A channel is connected once — after that you simply choose where the material goes.
public_saas_platforms_note: What each platform can do differs: publishing formats and the set of available figures are not the same everywhere. Some integrations offer separate ways to connect — a personal account and a page.
public_saas_analytics_body: After publication you can see views, reach and clicks for each channel. The next plan is built on facts rather than guesses.
public_saas_analytics_depth_note: How deep the figures go depends on the platform: some channels return views and reactions, others only the fact of publication.
public_saas_analytics_loop_body: The result of a publication will come back into the next plan, with plain conclusions about what to repeat and what not to.
public_saas_cta_title: Put the whole content process in one place
public_saas_cta_body: Start one piece of material and carry it through to publication — the whole path takes an evening.
about_source_body: The complete source of this exact version is available to download, as AGPL-3.0 requires of software you use over a network.
public_saas_adapt_text_facebook: Content marketing trends 2026: short video is reshaping the editorial plan. We collected six formats that fill a quarter and showed how to count the result per channel.
public_saas_adapt_text_youtube: Attention has moved to short-form video; the editorial process has not. What we changed in the quarterly plan: a six-episode series, one written breakdown per episode, one summary report.
public_saas_adapt_text_tiktok: Six clips this quarter, a breakdown for each. Here is why.
public_saas_adapt_text_instagram: We broke down what short video changes in a content plan. Six episodes, already in production.
public_saas_demo_nothing_leaves: A demo: nothing is stored, nothing is published, nothing leaves this page.
public_saas_demo_not_sent: Not sent: it did not fit
public_saas_demo_best_channel: {{channel}} brought the most clicks — that is what the next plan is built on.
public_saas_result_detail: The material has gone out. The figures are demo data, but they are broken down the way the product breaks them down: per channel, and only for the channels it actually reached.
public_saas_demo_no_channels: Choose at least one channel — the material has to go somewhere.
onboarding_next_description: Six steps through one piece of content: channel, voice, something to stand on, brief, draft, schedule. What is already done is ticked off for you.
